name: LovStudio BP 商业计划书工具包
examples_zh: 帮我从当前项目材料梳理一份种子轮商业计划书大纲
从零开始做一份完整的融资BP，按推荐方案
我有一份BP想润色一下，文字太技术了投资人看不懂
examples_en: Create a seed-round BP outline from my project materials
Generate a complete investor BP from scratch with recommended defaults
Polish my existing BP, the copy is too technical for investors
description_zh: 根据项目材料和用户目标，按需编排投资人商业计划书大纲、融资演示文稿、证据核验与专业审校流程；支持完整 BP 制作、融资 PPT 生成、已有材料续作和逐页润色。
description_en: Compose investor-ready business plans on demand: outline, pitch deck, evidence verification, and professional review. Supports full BP creation, fundraising PPT, existing material revision, and slide-by-slide polish.
